edges.reason: _transfer ends by delegating to _tokenTransfer for balance bookkeeping.
_transfer triggers swapTokens (external calls) before share accounting completes.
swapTokens calls swapTokensForEth, which performs an external router swap.
swapTokens calls sendETHToFee to push ETH to wallets.
swapTokens calls addLiquidity, an external router interaction.
sendETHToFee forwards its amount into the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
ETH transfer to a wallet can re-enter _transfer/swap path while inSwap accounting runs.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount into the router swap unsafe operation.
addLiquidity passes token/ETH amounts into the router liquidity unsafe operation.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, a miner-influenceable value.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidity deadline, a miner-influenceable value.
deliver derives the fee-paying sender from msg.sender.
transfer passes msg.sender as the from address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance updates.
approve writes allowances for msg.sender.
withDrawLeftoverETH trusts onlyOwner against msg.sender identity.
totalFee is the divisor for fee split math in swapTokens.
reflectionFee is rewritten inside _transfer to change charges per path.
launchedAt drives sniper marking and anti-bot tax decisions.
uniswapV2Router is the call target of swapTokensForEth.
withDrawLeftoverETH forwards the full balance into an ETH transfer.
withdrawStuckTokens calls external ERC20 transfer with the rescued balance.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rOwned of the caller.
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to accrue reflection fees.
multiTransfer loops over _transfer for each airdrop recipient.
multiTransfer_fixed loops over _transfer with a fixed amount.
setTaxesBuy rewrites totalFee from owner-supplied fee values.
setTaxesSell rewrites sell fee state used by _transfer.
openTrading sets launchedAt, enabling the anti-bot block logic.
openTrading toggles the global tradingOpen gate.
setNewRouter replaces uniswapV2Router with an owner-chosen address.
setWallets rewrites marketingWallet payout destination.
setSwapSettings rewrites swapThreshold controlling auto-swaps.
setMaxWalletPercent_base1000 rewrites the wallet cap.
_transfer writes _isSniper for recipients inside the dead-blocks window.
manage_Snipers sets blacklist status for owner-supplied addresses.
param_account is the address excluded and tokenFromReflection-converted.
param_to is the recipient used in the max wallet check.
param_from is the source wallet debited by multiTransfer.
local_contractTokenBalance is capped to swapThreshold and passed to swapTokens.
local_amountToLiquify is passed as the token side of addLiquidity.
local_SCCC accumulates token amounts before the balance check.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only feeds the owner-only reward exclusion routine and has no independent core identity.
Recipient parameter scoped entirely to the _transfer wallet cap and accounting logic.
Source address parameter exists solely to debit balances inside the airdrop loop.
Local capped balance is the direct token input of the swap routine.
Local liquidity token amount is the direct input to the liquidity add routine.
Local accumulator only supports the balance sufficiency check in the airdrop.
